package handler

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	sender "example.com/slg-practice/game/handler/syncsender"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/activity"
)

// 原服奖励到账只发一次，不依赖 wallet 的回执窗口（维护者 2026-11-17）：同一次活动奖励已到账、原服还没记 Delivered
// 时重投；而重投之前这名玩家又有超过 128 笔带业务键的入账（这里用 wallet 自带的 WalletGrant 发 129 笔），
// wallet 窗口里早已没有这次活动的回执。判重靠 Player 上的永久到账回执，重投不再加钱，换金额仍被拒。
func TestSLGAllianceRewardOnceBeyondWalletWindow(t *testing.T) {
	f := newSLGFixture(t)
	RegisterAllianceRewardsNestHandlers()
	RegisterWalletGrantNestHandlers()
	ctx := context.Background()
	s := sender.NewAllianceRewardsSender(f.engine)
	if _, err := s.Sync_AllianceHomeInit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	key := activity.Key{GroupID: "alliance", ActivityID: "season-1-window-1", Phase: activity.PhaseSettle}
	if coins, err := s.Sync_AllianceCredit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000, key, 10); err != nil || coins != 60 {
		t.Fatalf("first delivery coins=%d err=%v", coins, err)
	}
	grant := sender.NewWalletGrantSender(f.engine)
	for i := 0; i < 129; i++ {
		if _, err := grant.Sync_WalletGrant(ctx, f.subject.ID(), fmt.Sprintf("slg-other-%d", i), 1); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if coins := f.subject.Dao().GetWallet().GetCoins(); coins != 189 {
		t.Fatalf("other keyed credits coins=%d, want 189", coins)
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_AllianceCredit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000, key, 10); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if coins := f.subject.Dao().GetWallet().GetCoins(); coins != 189 {
		t.Fatalf("redelivery after 129 keyed credits paid again: coins=%d, want 189", coins)
	}
	if _, err := s.Sync_AllianceCredit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000, key, 11); err == nil || f.subject.Dao().GetWallet().GetCoins() != 189 {
		t.Fatalf("changed amount accepted: coins=%d err=%v", f.subject.Dao().GetWallet().GetCoins(), err)
	}
}

// slgFsyncWAL 按 WAL 的持久语义模拟提交器：strict 记录在 Commit 里即 fsync；async 记录 Commit 时只写进“页缓存”，
// 替身不跑组提交 ticker，所以用例里一直不持久；pipelined 记录 Enqueue 后挂起，用例调 fsync 才持久并完成票据。
// fsync 按前缀生效（与真实 WAL 一样，持久水位之前的记录全部持久）。auto 时每次写入后立即 fsync，供夹具准备数据。
type slgFsyncWAL struct {
	mu      sync.Mutex
	auto    bool
	records []dataengine.CommitRecord
	durable int // 已持久的前缀长度，即 DurableLSN
	pending []*slgPendingTicket
	waiting chan struct{} // 每张挂起的票据发一个信号：Nest 正在等这条记录持久
}

type slgPendingTicket struct {
	lsn  uint64
	done chan struct{}
}

func (t *slgPendingTicket) LSN() uint64           { return t.lsn }
func (t *slgPendingTicket) Done() <-chan struct{} { return t.done }
func (t *slgPendingTicket) Err() error            { return nil }

func newSLGFsyncWAL() *slgFsyncWAL {
	return &slgFsyncWAL{auto: true, waiting: make(chan struct{}, 16)}
}

func (w *slgFsyncWAL) Commit(_ context.Context, record dataengine.CommitRecord) error {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.records = append(w.records, record)
	if w.auto || record.Durability == dataengine.DurabilityStrict {
		w.fsyncLocked()
	}
	return nil
}

func (w *slgFsyncWAL) Enqueue(_ context.Context, record dataengine.CommitRecord) (nest.CommitTicket, error) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.records = append(w.records, record)
	ticket := &slgPendingTicket{lsn: uint64(len(w.records)), done: make(chan struct{})}
	w.pending = append(w.pending, ticket)
	if w.auto {
		w.fsyncLocked()
		return ticket, nil
	}
	select {
	case w.waiting <- struct{}{}:
	default: // 持锁调用不能阻塞；用例一次只等一张票据，缓冲足够
	}
	return ticket, nil
}

func (w *slgFsyncWAL) DurableLSN() uint64 {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	return uint64(w.durable)
}

func (w *slgFsyncWAL) fsyncLocked() {
	w.durable = len(w.records)
	for _, ticket := range w.pending {
		close(ticket.done)
	}
	w.pending = nil
}

func (w *slgFsyncWAL) fsync() {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.fsyncLocked()
}

// setAuto 切换自动 fsync；切回自动时先落定挂起的票据。
func (w *slgFsyncWAL) setAuto(auto bool) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	w.auto = auto
	if auto {
		w.fsyncLocked()
	}
}

// lastDurable 报告最近一条 handler 名含 name 的记录是否已持久，以及它的声明 durability。
func (w *slgFsyncWAL) lastDurable(name string) (durable bool, durability dataengine.Durability, found bool) {
	w.mu.Lock()
	defer w.mu.Unlock()
	for i := len(w.records) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
		if strings.Contains(w.records[i].Handler, name) {
			return i < w.durable, w.records[i].Durability, true
		}
	}
	return false, 0, false
}

// deliverPending 在到账（AllianceCredit）回复之后就在原服义务账本标完成，标完成之后不再重投；整机掉电丢掉已回复的
// 到账时奖励就丢了。所以到账必须在它的 WAL 记录持久之后才回复（维护者 2026-11-18 定 B：durability=pipelined）。
// 替身只在用例 fsync 时持久；用例在“标完成”那一刻核对到账记录已持久，并核对持久之前没有回复。退回 async 时变红。
func TestSLGAllianceCreditRepliesOnlyAfterItsRecordIsDurable(t *testing.T) {
	wal := newSLGFsyncWAL()
	f := newSLGFixtureWith(t, wal)
	RegisterAllianceRewardsNestHandlers()
	ctx := context.Background()
	s := sender.NewAllianceRewardsSender(f.engine)
	if _, err := s.Sync_AllianceHomeInit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	key := activity.Key{GroupID: "alliance", ActivityID: "season-1-window-durable", Phase: activity.PhaseSettle}
	wal.setAuto(false)
	t.Cleanup(func() { wal.setAuto(true) }) // 先于引擎关闭执行：失败时也落定挂起的票据
	type reply struct {
		coins      int64
		err        error
		durable    bool
		durability dataengine.Durability
		found      bool
	}
	replied := make(chan reply, 1)
	go func() {
		coins, err := s.Sync_AllianceCredit(ctx, f.subject.ID(), 1000, key, 10)
		// 这里就是 deliverPending 标完成的位置：记下此刻到账记录是否已持久。
		durable, durability, found := wal.lastDurable("AllianceCredit")
		replied <- reply{coins, err, durable, durability, found}
	}()
	var got reply
	select {
	case <-wal.waiting:
		// Nest 在等到账记录持久：持久之前不得回复。
		select {
		case got = <-replied:
			t.Fatalf("credit replied before its record was durable: %+v", got)
		case <-time.After(100 * time.Millisecond):
		}
		wal.fsync()
		select {
		case got = <-replied:
		case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
			t.Fatal("credit did not reply after its record became durable")
		}
	case got = <-replied:
		// 回复没有等任何持久票据（async 只写进页缓存；strict 在 Commit 里已持久）。
	case <-time.After(10 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("credit neither replied nor waited for durability")
	}
	if got.err != nil || !got.found || got.coins != 60 {
		t.Fatalf("credit coins=%d err=%v recorded=%v", got.coins, got.err, got.found)
	}
	if !got.durable {
		t.Fatalf("credit replied while its WAL record (durability=%v) was not durable: the obligation would be marked delivered for a credit that power loss can erase", got.durability)
	}
}
